# radio

Composed RokctAI app shell for a single-station radio app (Musina FM
lineage). `lib/` is generated by compose on every build from the SDKs
declared in `composer.json` - the vinyl record-player experience itself
lives in `radio_sdk` (RokctAI/agent, `radio/dart`), which is this app's
home SDK.

## How it fits together

- `composer.json` - the SDK roster (every enabled entry pinned by the
  sha256 of its `install.py`, as the compose guard requires). Copied from
  the canonical profile `core/utils/flutter/composer/radio.json` in
  The-Rokct-Protocol.
- `.rokct/` - protocol bootstrap (`initiate.py`, pinned to a protocol
  commit) and compose tooling cache (`.rokct/cache/`, gitignored).
- `pubspec.yaml` - host-owned: SDK path deps into `.rokct/cache/` plus the
  direct dependency block synced from the canonical shell template.
- `tour/app.tour.yaml` - the only place app branding lives; chains
  radio_sdk's brand-neutral tour fragment.
- `assets/` - tracked on purpose: brand images (`assets/images/`), fonts,
  and the SDK-installed player imagery (`assets/radio/`).
- `docs/legacy/` - verbatim copies of the pre-slice `lib/` files that were
  not ported into an SDK, with a disposition table. `docs/SLICE.md` is the
  original slicing classification.

## Per-app configuration

Station identity travels as `--dart-define`s (CI sets them from the app's
configuration): `RADIO_STREAM_URL`, `RADIO_STATION_NAME`, the drawer's
`RADIO_*_URL` links and `RADIO_DRAWER_LOGO`. Demo builds
(`--dart-define=IS_DEMO=true`) seed a demo station and mock artwork.
Android release signing is CI-injected (`android/key.properties` and the
keystore are not committed; the build falls back to the debug key without
them).

<!-- @generated-recompose-start -->
## Recomposing this app

`lib/` is fully installer-generated and disposable - it is safe to delete
and is gitignored. Anything app-specific lives in tracked manifests
(`app_routes`, or `host_routes` in `composer.json`), never in `lib/` itself.

To regenerate it:

```sh
python3 .rokct/initiate.py   # provisions the composer under .rokct/skills/
python3 .rokct/skills/.rok/flutter/scripts/compose.py
```

Session cleanup (`python3 .rokct/end_protocol.py`) wipes the provisioned
tools again.
<!-- @generated-recompose-end -->
